title: Kept the ex’s mug. Uses it daily.
caption: Taurus kept the ex's mug because it's comfy, and drinks from it every day. Letting go isn't losing, it's making room. Keep one kind memory if you like, and let the rest go at your own pace. Send this to the friend still using the mug.
